About the job
Sihlfeld Biologics is a contract development and manufacturing organisation (CDMO) for monoclonal antibodies and recombinant proteins. At our site in Zurich-Altstetten, 420 employees develop processes and manufacture clinical and commercial drug substance and sterile drug product for biotech customers in Europe and the US.

Following the approval of our second fill and finish line, we are preparing for a Swissmedic re-inspection in Q1 2027 and a pre-license inspection by the FDA later that year. Our Head of Quality Operations has moved to a global role within the group, so we are looking for an experienced interim leader to take over Quality Operations for nine months.

Your responsibilities
- Lead Quality Operations (shop floor QA, batch record review, batch disposition, QA validation) with a team of 34
- Ensure timely batch disposition in line with customer quality agreements and act as deputy of the site's Responsible Person under the Swissmedic manufacturing licence
- Drive deviation, CAPA and change control performance and reduce the deviation backlog by 50 %
- Lead inspection readiness for the Swissmedic and FDA inspections, including mock inspections and storyboards
- Implement the remaining actions from the EU GMP Annex 1 gap assessment (contamination control strategy, aseptic process simulations, environmental monitoring)
- Represent Quality in customer audits and in the site leadership team

Your profile
- University degree in pharmacy, life sciences or chemistry
- At least 12 years of experience in GMP quality assurance, including 5+ years leading QA teams in sterile or biologics manufacturing
- Proven experience with FDA and Swissmedic or EU inspections
- Deep knowledge of EU GMP including Annex 1, 21 CFR 210/211 and ICH Q9/Q10
- Qualification as EU Qualified Person or eligibility as Swiss Responsible Person is a strong plus
- Fluent English; German is an advantage

What we offer
- A 9-month interim assignment starting in November 2026, with a possible extension
- Full-time presence on site in Zurich; remote work is not possible for this role
- Daily rate of CHF 1,300 to 1,500, depending on experience, plus travel expenses
- Contract directly with Sihlfeld Biologics AG as an independent contractor

Sihlfeld Biologics is an equal opportunity employer.
